coverage.geography: United States and the Charitology project
limitations: Unknown historical baselines stay unknown. Capture time is not a source measurement or a historical served-edition timestamp.
This project has not measured worldwide giving, allocation by depth, counterfactual impact or sector-wide change.
Stocks, annual flows and ratios with different source periods cannot be added or read as an impact ranking.
coverage.scope: Dated U.S. financial estimates and a census of the Charitology project; not a worldwide charity census.

editorial.aiAssistance: Prepared with AI assistance. Independent human review has not been completed.
